hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; ext="${f##*.}"; if echo "$ext" | grep -qE '^(html|scss|toml)$'; then dir="$f"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; if [ -f "$dir/hugo.toml" ] || [ -f "$dir/config.toml" ] || [ -f "$dir/config/_default/hugo.toml" ]; then cd "$dir" && hugo build --quiet 2>&1 | tail -5; exit $?; fi; done; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qiE '\.[rR]$'; then /opt/homebrew/bin/air format "$f" 2>&1; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '/(layouts|archetypes)/'; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$f" | grep -qiE '\.(ya?ml|json|css|scss|html|md|qmd)$'; then /opt/homebrew/bin/prettier --write "$f" 2>&1; fi; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qiE '\.(sh|bash|zsh)$'; then /opt/homebrew/bin/shfmt -w -i 2 "$f" 2>&1; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.rs$'; then dir="$f"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; if [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ]; then cd "$dir" && cargo fmt -- "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10; exit $?; fi; done; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: Formatting Rust file with cargo fmt...

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.R$'; then Rscript -e "lintr::lint('$f')" 2>&1 | tail -20; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.R$'; then dir="$f"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; if [ -f "$dir/DESCRIPTION" ]; then cd "$dir" && Rscript -e 'devtools::test()' 2>&1 | tail -20; exit $?; fi; done; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.R$'; then dir="$f"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; if [ -f "$dir/DESCRIPTION" ]; then cd "$dir" && Rscript -e 'devtools::check()' 2>&1 | tail -30; exit $?; fi; done; fi; }
